caption:
Large Sahab Disapproves, No. 02. Five more crimes. Still zero forgiveness. 🥃

Which one have you committed? Confess below. Large Sahab already knows.

Tag the friend who calls everything “Scotch”.

And for the record: never drink and drive.

#LargeSahab #EkLarge #WhiskyLovers #DesiHumour

scenes.label: CRIME No. 1
scenes.title: Calling every whisky “Scotch.”
scenes.body: Scotch comes from Scotland. Amrut is from Bengaluru, beta.

scenes.label: CRIME No. 2
scenes.title: Clinking so hard the glass chips.
scenes.body: It’s a cheers, not a boxing match.

scenes.label: CRIME No. 3
scenes.title: Leaving the bottle open all night.
scenes.body: Cap it. The whisky deserves better.
